How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was pretty easy. There is a lot of facebook groups with a lot of rented furnished rooms in CDMX, but theyre often posted with short notice

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Its really nice because you automatically learn more neighbourhoods, but distances can be long as the city is big, so a good idea is to check transportation opportunities to campus.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You had a week or two to choose your courses, so you could "test" some out before choosing. There was help from UNAM to choose and register

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: To choose and register, also by which level the courses where on in terms of work load or spanish level

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: It was not the ones i wanted before comming, but it sorted out fine

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Check deadlines and rather ask someone for help than try to figure out everything on your own.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was a high level but the professors and other students where nice and friendly and helpfull, especially when spanish is not your first language.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Less group work, but other wise pretty similar. Way longer classes, with very little break.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1. Gramáticas de la creación en tres narradores hispanoamericanos
2. Literaturas de una resistencia: las voces canceladas en la literatura contemporánea
3. Literatura electrónica, interacción e inteligencia artificial

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
2. Literaturas de una resistencia: las voces canceladas en la literatura contemporánea 
if you are interested in litterature, you get presented many strong authors and books in this course.
